login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to ScholarHUB with your username and password.

loginTwofa.title: Two-factor verification
loginTwofa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
loginTwofa.sessionExpired: Verification session expired, please sign in again

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Create a ScholarHUB account to manage your academic work.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your registered email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sentNotice: If that email is registered, a reset email has been sent. Complete the reset within 30 minutes; the link looks like /reset-password?token=….
forgot.sentToast: If that email is registered, a reset email has been sent

reset.title: Reset password
reset.description: Enter the token from the email and your new password.

toast.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
toast.registerSuccess: Account created — check your inbox to verify your email
toast.resetRequestFailed: Request failed, please try again later
toast.resetSuccess: Password reset — please sign in with the new password
